# Contributing to imsomeeked

Thanks for helping! Bug reports, ideas and pull requests are all welcome.

- **Bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/meekwilliam/imsomeeked/issues/new/choose) using the bug form. The iOS version and connection type matter most.
- **Questions:** use [Discussions](https://github.com/meekwilliam/imsomeeked/discussions).
- **Code:** the Mac app is `Sources/imsomeeked/main.swift`, built with `./build.sh`. The Windows app is in `windows/`, and you run it with `python imsomeeked.py`. Keep changes focused, and describe how you tested them on a real iPhone.

By contributing, you agree that your contributions are licensed under the project's [MIT License](../LICENSE).
